items.title: 684 Yellow Leaf Ln, Summerville, SC 29486
items.description: Discover the property 684 Yellow Leaf Lane, Summerville, SC 29486 for sale. Welcome to The Hammocks at Cane Bay--where space, style, and lifestyle come together in one seriously impressive home.From the moment you arrive, this home makes a statement. A 3-car garage, durable fiber cement siding, custom hardscaping, and a fully fenced backyard set the stage. Out back, peaceful pond views create the perfect backdrop, whether you're relaxing on the screened porch or entertaining on the custom paver patio.Step inside and the heart of the home immediately takes center stage. The gourmet kitchen delivers with double ovens, a gas cooktop, farmhouse sink, granite countertops, and a bright, open floor plan designed to bring everyone together. The kitchen flows effortlessly into the dining and living spaces, making this home just as comfortable for a quiet night in a it is for hosting a crowd. The main-floor primary suite feels like its own private retreat, complete with a spa-inspired, glass-enclosed walk-in shower and an oversized walk-in closet. Also downstairs, French doors open to a dedicated office or flexible bonus space, while a convenient drop zone helps keep everyday life organized. And upstairs? The space keeps going. An enormous loft anchors the second floor alongside three additional bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including an ensuite. There's also a walk-in attic with exciting potential to be reimagined and possibly converted into additional living space. Then there's the feature you don't see every day: your own built-in golf simulator. No tee time required. Beyond the home, The Hammocks at Cane Bay delivers the lifestyle to match. This golf cart-friendly community offers access to two pools, parks, playgrounds, scenic walking trails, and neighborhood events ranging from food truck nights to holiday parades. Shops, restaurants, schools, and the YMCA are all conveniently nearby. More space. More ways to entertain. More reasons to stay home. This is Cane Bay living--with an upgrade.

items.title: 105 Rum Nck St, Summerville, SC 29486
items.description: Discover the property 105 Rum Neck Street, Summerville, SC 29486 for sale. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home showcases upgraded flooring, designer lighting, a spacious loft with balcony access, and a gourmet kitchen with a stunning butler's pantry designed for effortless entertaining and everyday convenience. The spacious primary suite features a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, a frameless tiled shower, and dual walk-in closets. Outdoor living shines with an extended patio, fenced backyard, garden area, and inviting front porch highlighted by a Charleston-style gas lantern.Additional upgrades include a built-in workspace nook, enhanced laundry room storage, Jack & Jill guest bath, and tasteful custom accents throughout. Residents enjoy access to Carnes Crossroads amenities including resort-style pools, playgrounds, fitness center, farm, dining, shopping, and schools nearby.

items.title: 131 Sandy Bend Ln, Summerville, SC 29486
items.description: Discover the property 131 Sandy Bend Lane, Summerville, SC 29486 for sale. Welcome to 131 Sandy Bend Lane, an exceptional residence in one of the most coveted locations in all of Nexton. Set along highly sought-after Sandy Bend Lane and positioned directly beside Nexton's iconic Rock the Block homes, backing to a pond an amenities this beautifully appointed residence offers an elevated Lowcountry lifestyle with an address that is truly hard to replicate. Spanning approximately 3,485 square feet, 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, this thoughtfully designed home offers the space, flexibility and architectural character today's most discerning buyers are looking for.From the moment you arrive, the home makes a statement with its beautiful curb appeal and prime Sandy Bend setting. Inside, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light and an inviting open-concept layout create a sophisticated yet comfortable atmosphere. The spacious living area is anchored by a fireplace and framed by oversized triple sliding glass doors, seamlessly extending the living space outdoors and capturing serene views beyond. The main level features a private owner's retreat designed for everyday luxury, complete with a generous walk-in closet and a thoughtfully designed owner's entry. A dedicated office provides the perfect setting for working from home, while the additional bedroom and living spaces offer flexibility for guests or everyday living. Upstairs, discover additional bedrooms, generous living space and a versatile bonus/loft area, creating plenty of room for guests, entertaining, hobbies or a second living area. With five bedrooms and multiple flexible spaces, the home effortlessly adapts to a variety of lifestyles. Step outside to enjoy the quintessential Lowcountry setting from the screened porch, where peaceful views and indoor-outdoor living come together beautifully. The home's position within Nexton places you moments from the community's renowned parks, trails, pools, fitness amenities, dining, shopping and everyday conveniences. And then there is the location. Sandy Bend Lane is one of Nexton's signature streets and Nexton offers an unmatched lifestyle with the Midtown Club's resort-style pool, lap lanes, fitness center, yoga studio, pickleball and tennis courts, The Living Room, social spaces, event lawns and playground, along with miles of walking and biking trails, parks, dog parks and community events. Dining, shopping, coffee, groceries and everyday conveniences are all just moments away.

items.title: 321 Prairie Point Pl, Summerville, SC 29486
items.description: Discover the property 321 Prairie Point Place, Summerville, SC 29486 for sale. Set on nearly three-quarters of an acre, 321 Prairie Point Place pairs the privacy and breathing room of a larger homesite with the elevated design and convenience of new construction. Currently under construction with anticipated completion in early 2027, the Azalea plan offers approximately 3,584 heated square feet, 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths and an attached 3-car side-entry garage.The main level is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, with an open great room and kitchen, separate dining area, private office, flex room, walk-in pantry, mudroom and powder room. Designed as the heart of the home, the kitchen is anchored by a large island with a farmhouse sink and built-in microwave drawer, along with a 36-inch range, pot filler and statement hood. Generous windows bring in abundant natural light, while 10-foot ceilings and thoughtfully selected finishes give the main level a bright, polished and upscale feel. Indoor and outdoor living flow together through a spacious 30-foot screened porch, complemented by a covered front porch that adds classic Lowcountry character. Upstairs, the home offers the primary suite, four additional bedrooms, laundry and an expansive loft that provides flexible space for a media room, game room, second living area or home office. The primary suite is designed as a private retreat with a large walk-in closet and spa-inspired bath featuring dual vanities, a separate shower and freestanding tub. Nine-foot ceilings continue throughout the second floor. Prairie Point Place also offers something increasingly difficult to find in new construction: freedom without sacrificing standards. There is no HOA, with only a limited set of C/Rs designed to help protect the quality and character of the five-home setting without the typical restrictions of a master-planned community. Bring the boat, trailer and other recreational toys, enjoy the oversized homesite, and take advantage of the space and flexibility that nearly three-quarters of an acre provides. The location delivers an appealing balance of privacy and accessibility. I-26 is less than 3 miles away, with approximately 9 miles to Nexton Square, 10 miles to the Volvo Cars Ridgeville campus, 23 miles to Charleston International Airport and 31 miles to Downtown Charleston. Shopping, dining, major employment centers and the greater Charleston area are all within easy reach. 321 Prairie Point Place brings together luxury new construction, nearly three-quarters of an acre, a 3-car garage, elevated finishes, flexible living spaces and no HOA in an intimate setting designed for buyers who want both quality and room to live on their own terms. Home is currently under construction with completion anticipated in early 2027. Floor plans, renderings, materials, finishes, features, room configurations and dimensions are subject to change and may vary in the completed home.

items.title: 108 Tandil Ct, Summerville, SC 29483
items.description: Discover the property 108 Tandil Court, Summerville, SC 29483 for sale. 108 Tandil Court offers four bedrooms, 2.5 baths and 2,373 square feet on a cul-de-sac in Summerville's Plum Creek neighborhood. A separate room near the front entry could serve as a home office, second sitting area or space for hobbies.The kitchen has 42-inch upper cabinets, a tile backsplash, generous counter space and a pantry. It opens to a breakfast nook with added cabinets for dishes and serving pieces. The adjoining living room has a gas fireplace, while a separate dining room provides space for larger meals. Sliding doors from the breakfast nook lead to a screened porch. Outside, the patio and fenced backyard leave room for a grill, a garden or a dog to run.All four bedrooms and the laundry room are upstairs. The primary suite has a walk-in closet and a recently renovated bathroom with a walk-in shower. The home also has a newer tankless water heater, and the refrigerator, washer and dryer convey. Plum Creek residents have access to a community pool and play park. Historic downtown Summerville and I-26 are each less than five miles away, and Nexton Square is under nine miles away for shopping, dining and entertainment. The home is in the Dorchester District Two school district.
